name: Silver
obtain_method_text__en: Random roll when an egg hatches.
notes__en: Silver is the most common mutation you can roll when an egg hatches, and the weakest boost. It is still worth keeping on an early pet, but a Golden or Rainbow version of the same pet earns far more.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Bloom
obtain_method_text__en: Sakura Incubator in Cherry Blossom during the Cherry Blossom event; also seen on random eggs in Admin Abuse events.
notes__en: Bloom comes from the Sakura Incubator during the Cherry Blossom event, so it is not a normal hatch roll. Its boost is only a little above Silver. Spirit Bloom from the same incubator is the much stronger result.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Golden
obtain_method_text__en: Random roll when an egg hatches.
notes__en: Golden is a random roll when an egg hatches and more than doubles a pet's income. It is the mutation we tested first in game: a Golden Chicken earned what our formula predicted. Golden is rarer than Silver but much easier to get than Rainbow.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Spirit Bloom
obtain_method_text__en: Sakura Incubator in Cherry Blossom during the Cherry Blossom event (rarer result than Bloom).
notes__en: Spirit Bloom is the rare result of the Sakura Incubator in the Cherry Blossom event. It gives the same boost as Golden, so it matters most on pets that cannot roll Golden easily. Outside the event you cannot get it.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Fractured
obtain_method_text__en: Mutation consumable used on an egg in your pen (about 10% success), or Rift Boss Mastery rewards.
notes__en: Fractured comes from a mutation consumable used on an egg in your pen, which only works some of the time, or from Rift Boss Mastery rewards. It beats Golden and ties with Scrambled. Use the consumable on your best egg, since a failed try is wasted.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Scrambled
obtain_method_text__en: Scrambled Mutation Consumable from Dr. Scramble's Experiment Shop, used on an egg (about 10% success).
notes__en: Scrambled comes from Dr. Scramble's Experiment Shop as a consumable you use on an egg, with a low success rate. It gives the same boost as Fractured. Save it for a high-income pet rather than a starter.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Parasite
obtain_method_text__en: Hatching a Parasite Egg from the Hungry Monster feeding event.
notes__en: Parasite comes only from hatching a Parasite Egg in the Hungry Monster feeding event. It is the second-strongest mutation, above Fractured and Scrambled. Because it is tied to an event, check the updates page to see when it returns.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table

name: Rainbow
obtain_method_text__en: Very rare random roll when an egg hatches.
notes__en: Rainbow is the rarest random roll when an egg hatches and the strongest mutation in the game. A Rainbow pet earns several times its normal income. If you hatch one on a high-rarity pet, keep it in your pen.
source_note: Multiplier from the wiki mutations table
